ground.policy: lowest valid toe marker minus standoff, along the ground normal
ground.stance_rule: heights relative to address; both feet flat at frame 0

foot_progression.notes: trail foot: owner style target 20 deg (#12683, owner-set, not measured); lead foot: capture address median (ankle-toe axis, malleolus-corrected)

reference_zmp.description: zero-moment point the tracked reference demands of this model against the support polygon of the spheres on the plane at each frame; outside means no unilateral foot contact can realise the reference there

finish_feasibility.description: finish-window feasibility of the tracked reference (the load its inverse dynamics demands) and of the simulation (the load the plant delivers); reference friction uses the net ground reaction, the simulation the larger of the two feet; an unloaded frame is never inside the support polygon

plan.impact_rule: lowest clubhead point within 0.05 s of peak speed
plan.gaze_axis_rule: head-frame direction of the address line of sight to the ball

head_gaze.note: replay is computed-torque tracking of the tracked reference; the neck follows the marker-driven IK reference

qualification: kinematic IK and computed-torque tracking milestone on the MuJoCo full-body model (anthropometric geometry (AN-1); unqualified until Simscape parity); not a fit, not acceptance

gates.name: max_normal_force_n
gates.reason: missing contact forces in dynamics receipt

plan.impact_rule: lowest clubhead point within 0.05 s of peak speed
plan.gaze_axis_rule: head-frame direction of the address line of sight to the ball

address_to_impact_nominal_axis.note: head +x axis as the gaze axis (not calibrated at address)

turn.frame_convention: Z up, golfer faces -X, target line -Y; yaw = atan2(y, x) of the right-to-left line in the XY plane; turn = -(yaw - yaw_at_address), unwrapped, positive in the backswing

definitions.shoulder_girdle: ShoulderBack markers (scapular/acromial) or shoulder joint centres
definitions.upper_trunk: BackLeft/BackRight markers or thorax-fixed model points
definitions.pelvis: WaistLeft/WaistRight markers or hip joint centres
